sec.title: September 5 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 833)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **September 5** across two hard-hitting investigative newspaper exposés on *Big Town* starring Edward Pawley and Fran Carlon for Lifebuoy Soap (1944, 1950), Richard Widmark narrating the industrial saga of the Mesabi iron range on *Cavalcade of America* for DuPont (1950), Bill Stern interviewing New York Giants home-run slugger Johnny Mize for Colgate (1947), underwater children's fantasy on *The Land of the Lost* (1944), and occult terror in *The House and the Brain* on *The Weird Circle* (1943), Edward Pawley & Fran Carlon (1944, 1950), Johnny Mize (1947), and Richard Widmark (1950):
